notes.title: 3 New Dates: Update release news and screenshots
notes.notes:
Hello everyone.

As promised in the announcements in the past couple of months, THREE new dates will be added to the game as a free update. I can now confirm that the update with these new dates will become available sometime next week, so keep an eye out for the announcement on that!

And in a meantime, here are a few screenshots to get you excited for the 3 new women that you'll be able to date.
